verses.text: And David said unto Nathan, I have sinned against the Lord. And Nathan said unto David, The Lord also hath not put away thy sin that thou shalt not die.

title: JST, 2 Samuel 12:13. Compare 2 Samuel 12:13 David’s grievous sin is not put away by God.
